dataset.description: Fictional, locally generated engagement-only data; no personal attributes or appointment outcome labels.

previous_appointments.meaning: Synthetic count of prior appointments; capped at 15.

previous_no_shows.meaning: Synthetic prior missed-appointment count, bounded by prior appointments.

portal_activity.meaning: Synthetic count of portal actions before a hypothetical appointment.

preprocessing.fit_scope: entire unlabeled dataset, for unsupervised clustering
preprocessing.clustering_space: all five imputed and standardized input features

kmeans.selection_rule: The reported descriptive solution uses the k with the highest silhouette score among the tested values; this is a heuristic.

visualization.method: PCA with two components, fitted to standardized features
visualization.purpose: visualization only; clustering is performed in five dimensions

limitations: All records and relationships are synthetic and have no clinical meaning.
Cluster labels are arbitrary identifiers, not diagnoses or risk categories.
Silhouette and inertia are internal heuristics and do not establish useful real-world segments.
DBSCAN results depend strongly on eps, feature scaling, and local density.
